note: Tome Sync Autoclean is an experimental glue sub-module with NO config, permissions, routes, or Drush command. Its entire behavior is one event subscriber (ExportEventSubscriber) on tome_sync.export_content that auto-runs Tome's unused-file cleanup (like drush tome:clean-files) after each export; enabling the module is the whole setup, and it can cause data loss. Because there is no config/state to read or write, the only meaningful, verifiable execution is the module's own install state. The hard case therefore has the agent ENABLE the experimental module: reset uninstalls it (verify FAILS), the agent enables it, verify passes, and cleanup re-enables it so the site baseline (all Tome sub-modules enabled) is preserved. NOTE: module install/uninstall triggers a full container rebuild and takes ~1-2 minutes per operation on this host; this was smoke-tested (reset->FAIL, enable->PASS) and the module was left enabled.

evals.prompt: What does the tome_sync_autoclean module do, and which manual Drush command's behavior does it automate?
evals.expected_output: It automatically deletes unused exported files after every Tome Sync export, automating what 'drush tome:clean-files' does manually. It is experimental and can cause data loss.

evals.prompt: How do you turn tome_sync_autoclean's behavior on and off? Does it have a settings page?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page or configuration. Enable the module to turn the auto-cleanup on ('drush en tome_sync_autoclean -y'); uninstall it to turn it off ('drush pmu tome_sync_autoclean -y').

evals.prompt: Technically, how does tome_sync_autoclean hook into Tome Sync to trigger cleanup? Name the event.
evals.expected_output: It registers an event subscriber (ExportEventSubscriber) on the TomeSyncEvents::EXPORT_CONTENT ('tome_sync.export_content') event and runs the clean-files logic after content is exported.

evals.prompt: Inspect this running site: is the experimental tome_sync_autoclean module enabled, and what Tome Sync event does it subscribe to?
evals.expected_output: tome_sync_autoclean is enabled (check 'drush pm:list'); its ExportEventSubscriber subscribes to tome_sync.export_content and auto-runs the unused-file cleanup after each export.

evals.prompt: A site owner wants stray unused files cleaned up automatically on every Tome export. Enable the experimental Tome sub-module that provides this, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable tome_sync_autoclean, e.g. 'drush en tome_sync_autoclean -y'. Verify passes when \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('tome_sync_autoclean') is TRUE.
